mapper.sql: SELECT att05_pm_work_id AS pm_work_id , att05_work_date AS work_date , att05_reason AS reason , att05_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_status_cd AS status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS status_name , policy.att01_pm_work_start_time || ' ~ ' || policy.att01_pm_work_end_time AS time_str , att01_break_minutes AS break_minutes , EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (policy.att01_pm_work_end_time::time - policy.att01_pm_work_start_time::time - (policy.att01_break_minutes * INTERVAL '1 minute')))::int || '시간 ' || LPAD(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (policy.att01_pm_work_end_time::time - policy.att01_pm_work_start_time::time - (policy.att01_break_minutes * INTERVAL '1 minute')))::int::text, 2, '0') || '분' AS work_time_str FROM att05_pm_work LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = att05_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT att01_pm_work_start_time , att01_pm_work_end_time , att01_break_minutes FROM att01_work_policy WHERE att01_company_id = att05_company_id AND att01_use_yn = 'true' AND att01_start_date <= att05_work_date ORDER BY att01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) policy ON TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM att03_overtime_req WHERE att03_person_id = #{personId} AND att03_work_date = #{baseDate}::date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO att05_pm_work ( att05_pm_work_id, att05_company_id, att05_person_id, att05_work_date, att05_reason ) VALUES ( #{pmWorkId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{workDate}, #{reason} )
